> 第445章 别来惹我（第1页）
见唐婉清不再那么的抗拒，柳大春托着她的臀部往自己这边挪了挪，按了按。
唐婉清一下子更急了：“你，你，你用什么检查啊？怎么检查啊？”
唐婉清也是成年女人，一下子就反应了过来：“你准备？？”
“啊？不要！”唐婉清更加难为情了。
但是柳大春已经开始“检查”她了。
市蝎犯罪分部被柳大春端了后自然惹怒了总部的幕后资本大佬们。
那斯文眼镜男不过只是执行者，真正的幕后大佬都是躲在后面的有钱人。
这些有钱人，真正掌控蝎犯罪集团的权势。
他们甚至不是黑的，是正儿八经的商人，是白的，不过是洗白的。
“玄武市的分部没了，金沙镇的那条走私路现在没人走了，对我们损失巨大，这事，各位怎么处理？”
“这个柳大是怎么一回事？”一号人物问道。
“我们走私过程中，被他碰到，他抢了我们的一个佛鼎，我们派了几波人去暗杀他，都被干掉了，也因此惹怒了他，他直接把玄武市分部给一口端了。”
和那名斯文眼镜男直接对接的大佬解释道。
“几个解决方案，一个是杀了他；一个是那万佛鼎就归他了，分部重新建，生意继续做；最好的方式应该是把他拉拢到我们的队伍。”一号人物的格局还是很大的。
把他们一个分部全杀了，还想拉拢柳大春？
“我们蝎可是少有威望的，如果分部被人端了，全杀光了都忍气吞声，以后在这个场子里还怎么混？这事传到境外势力那，生意还怎么做？”二号人物当即反对。
“就是，把我们的人都杀光了，是觉得我们好欺负了？？”三号人物抽着雪茄，显然也很不爽。
“他不是很强吗？那就找比他更强的人来，我要砍下他的脑袋，泡在水缸里，就当是景观了。别忘了，老蝎可是我外孙。”三号人物没给好脸色。

“他不是修仙吗？那就找修仙的，我们有的是钱，什么高手找不到？？区区一个贱民，还踩在我们头上？我们现在成笑话了。”三号人物很愤怒的说道。
“咱们可想清楚了，这个人报复心很强，我们已经暗杀过他好几次，失败了，他直接反杀过来。如果我们这次找的高手还杀不掉他的话，就不怕他杀到这里来吗？？”
“他还有这本事？？”三号人物不信。
“既然是修仙者，那普通的保镖来说可没用，他一个小时就端了市分部，几十个杀手，那些杀手也都是训练有素的，直接碾压式的杀光了，你们没看监控录像吗？”四号人物说着，起了身，去把备份的监控视频播放了出来。
总统套房内的大厅，瞬间死一样寂静。
柳大春无比冷血的杀人方式，不带一丝犹豫的果决，那种杀伐果断，看得这些人毛骨悚然。
甚至，杀光人后，柳大春还特意看着监控摄像头，就像是看着现在的这些人。
“看到他最后看我们的样子了吧，他那是在警告我们，不要去惹他。”

> Chapter 445 Don’t mess with me (page 1)
Seeing that Tang Wanqing was no longer so resistant, Liu Dachun moved her butt towards him and pressed it.
Tang Wanqing suddenly became even more anxious: "You, you, what test do you use? How do you check it?"
Tang Wanqing was also an adult woman and she immediately reacted: "Are you ready??"
"Ah? No!" Tang Wanqing became even more embarrassed.
But Liu Dachun had already begun to "check" her.
After the City Scorpion Crime Branch was taken over by Liu Dachun, it naturally angered the capital bosses behind the headquarters.
The gentle man with glasses is just the executor, the real bosses behind the scenes are the rich people hiding behind.
These wealthy people truly control the power of the Scorpion criminal group.
They are not even black, they are serious businessmen, they are white, but they are just whitewashed.
"The branch in Xuanwu City is gone, and the smuggling road in Jinsha Town is no longer used, which has caused huge losses to us. How will you deal with this matter?"
"What's going on with this Liu Da?" Number one asked.
"While we were smuggling, he encountered him and he robbed one of our Buddha tripods. We sent several waves of people to assassinate him, but they were all killed. This made him angry, and he directly killed the Xuanwu City branch."
The boss who was directly connected to the gentle man with glasses explained.
"There are several solutions, one is to kill him; the other is to give the Ten Thousand Buddhas Cauldron to him, re-establish the branch, and continue the business; the best way is to draw him into our team." The pattern of the No. 1 figure is still very big.
After killing all their branches, you still want to win over Liu Dachun?
"We Scorpions have little prestige. If the branch is taken over and everyone is killed but we still tolerate it, how can we still survive in this place in the future? If this matter spreads to overseas forces, how can we do business?" The number two figure immediately objected.
"You mean, they killed all our people because they thought we were easy to bully??" The third figure was smoking a cigar and was obviously unhappy.
"Isn't he very strong? Then find someone stronger than him. I will cut off his head and soak him in a water tank, and treat him as a spectacle. Don't forget, Lao Xie is my grandson." The third figure did not give a good look.
"Isn't he a cultivator? Then find a cultivator. We have a lot of money. Why can't we find a master?? A mere pariah steps on us? We have become a joke now." Number 3 said angrily.
"Let's think clearly. This man is very vindictive. We have assassinated him several times and failed. He just came back to kill him. If the master we found this time can't kill him, aren't we afraid that he will come here?"
"He still has this ability??" Figure 3 didn't believe it.
"Since he is a cultivator, ordinary bodyguards are useless. He took over the city branch in an hour, with dozens of killers. Those killers were also well-trained, and they killed them all in a crushing manner. Didn't you see the surveillance video?" Figure No. 4 said, stood up, and played the backup surveillance video.
The hall in the presidential suite fell into deathly silence for an instant.
Liu Dachun's extremely cold-blooded killing method, his decisiveness without a trace of hesitation, and his decisiveness of killing made these people's hair stand on end.
Even after killing everyone, Liu Dachun deliberately looked at the surveillance camera as if looking at these people now.
"You saw the way he looked at us at the end. He was warning us not to mess with him."
